# passwordsafe_secret_totp_code (Data Source)

Secret TOTP Code Datasource, gets the current TOTP code of a credential secret. Requires API version 3.3. The code is stored in the state as a sensitive value and is read again on every plan and refresh.

## Example Usage

```terraform
// current TOTP code of a credential secret (API version 3.3)
data "passwordsafe_secret_totp_code" "totp" {
  secret_id = passwordsafe_credential_secret.my_totp_credenial_secret.id
}
output "totp_code" {
  value     = data.passwordsafe_secret_totp_code.totp.code
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `secret_id` (String) ID of a credential secret with TOTP enabled

### Read-Only

- `code` (String, Sensitive) Current TOTP code
- `valid_from_utc` (String) Start of the code validity window (inclusive), RFC 3339
- `valid_to_utc` (String) End of the code validity window (exclusive), RFC 3339
